title: Clinical Trial Associate II
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II


Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.


Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Sr. Principal Backend Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $7,000 - $8,500 USD


Our partner revolutionizes clinical decision support by enhancing diagnostic accuracy and personalizing care. They modernize the diagnostic process by automating optimal lab test selection and interpretation, leveraging expert medical insights, real-world data, and artificial intelligence.


Their platform orchestrates and automates the entire diagnostic journey, reducing clinical complexity while integrating comprehensive medical histories and collective platform knowledge. They combine AI-driven clinical decision automation with instant provider payments, removing administrative and financial barriers for healthcare providers. This approach streamlines workflows, improves diagnostic accuracy, supports provider profitability, and enables clinicians to focus on delivering precise, individualized patient care.



Job Details:

We are seeking a Principal Backend Engineer to lead the design and development of our core platform services and integrations. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, systems-level thinking, and experience leading complex backend initiatives. This role is hands-on and strategic, guiding architectural decisions while mentoring engineers across the backend team.


As a principal engineer, you will influence platform design, scalability, reliability, and security at a company-wide level, working closely with product, data, and operations teams to deliver mission-critical functionality.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and reliable backend platform services and APIs.
  • Define architectural standards and best practices for backend services and integrations across the company.
  • Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Mentor and guide backend engineers, sharing technical expertise and promoting engineering excellence.
  • Build and maintain robust integrations with third-party systems, ensuring seamless data exchange and operational reliability.
  • Identify and drive performance optimization, scalability improvements, and platform enhancements.
  • Implement advanced monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to maintain high system availability.
  • Influence technical strategy and participate in cross-functional architectural decisions.
  • Experience with HL7/FHIR and healthcare interoperability standards is a strong plus.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of backend development experience, with expertise in designing platform services and complex integrations.
  • Deep proficiency in Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, MongoDB, SQL/noSQL, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong systems thinking and experience leading technical architecture for complex domains.
  • Proven ability to mentor and guide engineering teams, setting high technical standards.
  • Experience working in complex domains, ideally U.S. Healthcare.
  • English fluency required.
  • Previous experience working at Nubank or a similar fintech is highly desirable.


Strengths We Value:

  • Strategic, systems-level thinking and ownership of end-to-end backend architecture.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments while maintaining high reliability and correctness.
  • Mentorship and knowledge-sharing skills that elevate the engineering team.
  • Pragmatic, performance-oriented approach to platform scalability, observability, and operational resilience.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Software Developer (React.js / Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystem, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers having lead the market since 2014. title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.


The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.


About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.


What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)


You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects


What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary


Want some Bonus Points?

title: Product Owner
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 58541 e 58598


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Principais responsabilidades


  • Atuar como Product Owner, sendo responsável pela gestão e priorização do backlog do produto.
  • Escrever e refinar estórias de usuário claras, objetivas e bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite bem definidos.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre stakeholders de negócio e time de desenvolvimento.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Planning, Review, Retrospective e Daily)
  • Remover impedimentos e apoiar o time na melhoria contínua.
  • Monitorar métricas de desempenho e evolução do produto.
  • Atuar em ambiente estruturado sob o framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida em gestão ágil de projetos.
  • Vivência prática como Product Owner.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita, especialmente para elaboração de: estórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e documentação funcional.


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimento e atuação em ambientes com SAFe.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSPO, PSM, SAFe Agilist, entre outras).
  • Experiência com produtos digitais ou tecnologia.


Modelo de atuação


  • 100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.

  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product

Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree

  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Product Owner
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 58541 e 58598


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Principais responsabilidades


  • Atuar como Product Owner, sendo responsável pela gestão e priorização do backlog do produto.
  • Escrever e refinar estórias de usuário claras, objetivas e bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite bem definidos.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre stakeholders de negócio e time de desenvolvimento.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Planning, Review, Retrospective e Daily)
  • Remover impedimentos e apoiar o time na melhoria contínua.

Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida em gestão ágil de projetos.
  • Vivência prática como Product Owner.

  • Conhecimento e atuação em ambientes com SAFe.

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Vaga Desenvolvedor API/Backend


Estamos buscando uma pessoa desenvolvedora backend com experiência em Python / FastAPI para atuar no desenvolvimento de novas features e integrações de um SaaS de Inteligência Artificial.

Nosso produto é uma plataforma de Agentic AI, construída sobre Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e voltada para empresas que desejam escalar conversas automatizadas e integrar canais, pagamentos e agenda em um só lugar.


Sobre a Bren


A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades


  • Evoluir o backend da plataforma (FastAPI + Google Cloud)
  • Integrar sistemas de terceiros no app (ex: fornecedores e gateways de pagamento, calendário Google e Outlook)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o resto do time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura)


Stack


  • Linguagem:  Python
  • Framework:  FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura:  Google Cloud Platform
  • Principal API externa:  WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta)


Perfil Ideal


  • Experiência comprovada com APIs e integrações externas
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas escaláveis e microserviços
  • Experiência com Google Cloud (ou AWS/Azure equivalente)
  • Conhecimento em autenticação ( OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e queries de SQL
  • Experiência com API da Meta e Whatsapp Flow é um diferencial


Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

title: 11161 - Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedores Salesforce (Sêniores e Especialistas), altamente qualificados para atuarem em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade, com foco na implementação, customização e manutenção de soluções na plataforma Salesforce! ✨


Requisitos:

Graduação completa;

Possuir domínio avançado em Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce e SOQL;

Experiência prática com Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD e gerenciamento de pacotes é essencial;

Deve ter conhecimento sólido no uso de ferramentas declarativas como Flow, Process Builder, Validation Rules e Permission Sets;

É fundamental ter experiência comprovada em integração de sistemas via APIs REST e SOAP, com autenticação OAuth 2.0 e uso de Named Credentials;

Conhecimento de arquitetura multiorganização (multi-org), gerenciamento de ambientes sandbox e estratégia de versionamento de código são importantes;

Desejável experiência com frameworks de testes automatizados e uso de ferramentas como Jest para LWC;

É esperado domínio dos módulos Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, além de conhecimento prático em gerenciamento de dados com Data Loader ou Workbench.


Certificações Salesforce são desejáveis, mas não obrigatórias, o foco está na experiência técnica comprovada em projetos complexos e de grande escala!

Outros diferenciais: Experiência com Financial Cloud, B2B commerce, CRM, Agentforce.


Responsabilidades :

Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas utilizando Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e outras tecnologias da plataforma, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. A posição exige grande autonomia técnica, capacidade de análise crítica de requisitos e experiência com o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento dentro do ecossistema Salesforce, incluindo integração com sistemas externos e deploy controlado via Salesforce DX;

Liderará o desenvolvimento técnico de soluções na plataforma Salesforce, desde a análise de requisitos até a entrega em produção;

Deverá implementar funcionalidades customizadas utilizando Apex, LWC, Visualforce e configurações declarativas quando apropriado. Também será responsável por modelar objetos e relacionamentos no Salesforce Data Model, configurar workflows, Process Builder, Flow e validações de dados;

Espera-se que atue na integração da plataforma com APIs REST e SOAP externas, utilizando Named Credentials e Auth Providers quando necessário. Também será responsável por garantir a qualidade do código através de testes unitários com alta cobertura, revisão de código e aplicação de design patterns aderentes ao Salesforce;

Participará ativamente de cerimônias ágeis, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e orientando desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Modalidade de trabalho: 100% Home-Office, podendo residir em qualquer região do Brasil!!!

title: DGB Americas Regional Sales Manager
description:
Job Title: Regional Sales Manager

Department: Sales Distributors/TR

Location: Brazil


About DG Beauty:

Dolce & Gabbana Beauty is part of the global Dolce & Gabbana Group, embodying the brand’s bold identity, Italian heritage, and commitment to excellence. Our Beauty division continues to grow rapidly across fragrance and beauty categories, driven by strong partnerships, high-performance teams, and a focus on Retail Excellence.


Role Overview:

The Retail Sales Executive is responsible for driving sales performance, market share growth, and brand excellence within an assigned geographic area and client portfolio. This role plays a critical part in executing commercial strategies, managing field teams, and building strong, long-term partnerships with retail clients while ensuring consistent brand execution at point of sale.

The Retail Sales Executive works closely with the Area Manager and cross-functional teams to deliver results aligned with business objectives, brand guidelines, and budget expectations.


Key Job Accountabilities:

Sales Growth & Market Share

  • Increase sales and gain market share in line with targets set by the Area Manager.
  • Achieve monthly sales growth above market through execution of the Action Plan and promotional initiatives.

Client Management & Commercial Development

  • Motivate and manage clients within the assigned geographic area and portfolio.
  • Coordinate sales development in line with brand guidelines and client needs.
  • Build strong, positive, and long-term relationships to strengthen client loyalty and partnership.

Field Team Leadership

  • Manage Beauty Advisors and temporary payroll agency resources.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, development, coaching, and motivation of field teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner effectively with Training, Marketing, Merchandising, Finance, and Customer Service.
  • Align cross-functional support to deliver sales objectives and operational excellence.

Retail Excellence & Brand Execution

  • Contribute to Retail Excellence at point of sale.
  • Ensure brand image, visual standards, and merchandising guidelines are consistently respected.

Market Analysis & Assortment Optimization

  • Analyze market trends, competition, and customer insights to identify opportunities.
  • Review and optimize client assortment with focus on best sellers and inventory health.

Budget & Investment Management

  • Manage travel expense budgets and A&P investments for assigned clients.
  • Measure ROI of promotional and commercial activities in coordination with the Area Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute sales strategies and promotional plans across assigned accounts.
  • Conduct regular store visits to coach teams, assess execution, and monitor performance.
  • Ensure flawless execution of product launches and in-store initiatives.
  • Monitor KPIs, sales results, and productivity metrics, providing insights and action plans when needed.
  • Maintain accurate reporting and timely communication with internal stakeholders.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in retail sales, field sales, or account management within beauty, luxury, or consumer goods.
  • Proven experience managing field teams and working with retail partners.
  • Strong understanding of retail operations, visual merchandising, and commercial execution.
  • Experience working with budgets, forecasts, and ROI tracking.


Travel Requirements

  • Frequent travel within the assigned geographic area, including overnight stays as required.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar de forma remota em um projeto estratégico de engenharia de dados, focado na construção e evolução de pipelines escaláveis, integração entre sistemas e suporte à tomada de decisão orientada por dados. O profissional atuará em um ambiente moderno, trabalhando com grandes volumes de dados, processamento distribuído e arquitetura em cloud.


Responsabilidades:


• Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e performáticos.

• Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados, garantindo qualidade, integridade e disponibilidade.

• Implementar integrações de dados via APIs (REST) e/ou mensageria.

• Desenvolver soluções de processamento distribuído e otimização de consultas SQL.

• Automatizar deploys e provisionamento de recursos utilizando princípios de infraestrutura como código.

• Orquestrar workflows de dados garantindo monitoramento, versionamento e observabilidade.

• Colaborar com equipes técnicas e áreas de negócio para transformar requisitos em soluções eficientes de engenharia de dados.

Requisitos:


• Experiência sólida com Python para manipulação de dados, automações e integrações.

• Domínio de SQL avançado , incluindo modelagem e otimização de consultas.

• Experiência com processamento distribuído e conceitos de computação em cluster.

• Experiência com arquitetura de dados em ambientes cloud .

• Experiência com integração de dados via APIs e tratamento de erros em integrações.

• Conhecimento em versionamento de código e práticas de DevOps/DataOps (Git) .

• Noções de infraestrutura como código e automação de provisionamento.

• Experiência com orquestração de pipelines e workflows de dados .


Diferenciais:

• Experiência com Databricks, Spark ou processamento distribuído .

• Vivência com data lakes e query engines distribuídos (Trino, Dremio) .

• Experiência com orquestradores de pipelines como Airflow .

• Conhecimento em CI/CD e plataformas de versionamento como GitLab .

• Experiência com infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform .



Se você gosta de trabalhar com desafios de dados em escala, arquitetura moderna e construção de soluções que geram impacto real no negócio, essa oportunidade pode fazer sentido para você

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Gerente de Investigação Forense
description:
Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.


Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.


Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.


Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.


Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo.

Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativos

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). What You’ll Do
